lead.en: Routing answers a request; a service is what you deploy. moonzero puts the application inside that, and the seam between the two is one function: `to_asgi`.
lead.zh: 路由负责回答请求，服务才是你要部署的东西。moonzero 把应用装进服务里，两者之间的缝就是一个函数：`to_asgi`。

foot.zh: 第 06 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: `assemble` is the whole assembly: a name for the service, the server around the routed application, the layer the deployment expects, and the lowering to the interface the transport accepts.
text.zh: `assemble` 就是全部装配：给服务一个名字、把路由后的应用包进服务器、装上部署需要的层，再降到传输接受的那个接口。

text.en: `to_asgi` is the boundary. Above it are moonzero's types — configuration, groups, middleware with go-zero's names. Below it is an `AsgiApp`, which is all mooncat has ever asked for.
text.zh: `to_asgi` 是那条边界。上面是 moonzero 的类型 —— 配置、分组、带 go-zero 名字的中间件；下面是一个 `AsgiApp`，mooncat 要的从来只是这个。

text.en: The logging layer writes through the process logger, and the process logger hides everything below `Severe` until it is told otherwise. A freshly started service therefore looks silent — that is a level, not a missing feature.
text.zh: 日志层写进进程日志器，而进程日志器在没被交代之前会藏起 `Severe` 以下的一切。所以刚启动的服务看起来是安静的 —— 那是级别，不是缺功能。

text.en: The line is written by the outer layer after the route has answered, so it describes a finished request. A 404 is logged too: a request that arrived and found nothing is exactly what an access log is for.
text.zh: 这一行由外层在路由回答之后写出，所以它描述的是一次已完成的请求。404 也会被记下：一个到达了却没找到东西的请求，正是访问日志存在的理由。

text.en: A group takes the prefix once and every route inside it is relative. The application does not know the prefix, and the group does not know the route's handler — which is what lets the same handler be mounted twice under two prefixes.
text.zh: 分组只接受一次前缀，里面的路由都写相对路径。应用不知道前缀，分组也不知道路由的处理函数 —— 于是同一个处理函数可以挂在两个前缀下。

items.en: Drop `.use_(@zero.logging)` and run the access-log example again. The two lines disappear; the responses do not change, which is the point of a middleware.
items.zh: 去掉 `.use_(@zero.logging)`，再跑一次访问日志示例。两行消失，响应不变 —— 这正是中间件的意思。

items.en: Register a second layer after the first and print the order the lines arrive in. The last one registered is the outermost.
items.zh: 在第一个之后再加一层，打印两行到达的顺序。最后注册的那层在最外面。

items.en: Mount the `/api/v1` group twice, under two prefixes, in the nine-in-one example. One handler, two addresses, no second registration.
items.zh: 在全家桶示例里把 `/api/v1` 分组挂两次、用两个前缀。一个处理函数，两个地址，没有第二次注册。

items.en: Say which statement in `assemble` is the boundary between the two libraries.
items.zh: 说出 `assemble` 里哪一条语句是两个库之间的边界。

items.en: Read an access log line and say which layer wrote it and when.
items.zh: 读懂一行访问日志，说出是哪一层、在什么时候写的。

items.en: Explain why a silent service is a log level rather than an error.
items.zh: 解释服务安静是日志级别，而不是出了错。

items.en: Mount one handler under two prefixes.
items.zh: 把一个处理函数挂在两个前缀下。
